name: Colir
one_liner: Browser-based WebGL gradient editor that uses X/Y curves and effects to make non-default raster gradients.
what_it_offers: A GPU-accelerated (WebGL) editor where you set color stops, then drag separate X and Y curves to shape how color flows across the canvas, layering noise, glitter, feathering, distortion and patterns with 12 blend modes and 9 color-theory palettes. Exports PNG or WebP at 1x-4x scale, has a share link, a templates library (Aurora, Magma, Plasma, etc.) and a Figma Community plugin; animated gradients are on the roadmap.
tech_stack: Vanilla JS + WebGL shader programs (plain script files, lz-string for share links); landing page uses GSAP + ScrollTrigger; Google Sign-In (GSI); Paddle billing
portfolio_fit_reason: Makes distinctive grainy, curve-shaped gradient art that can set a portfolio's mood, but it exports raster images only, and client work needs PRO. It is a niche background-asset tool, not a core build resource.
client_ok_note: The free plan is personal use only. Commercial and client use needs PRO ($9/mo, $59/yr or $99 lifetime), and the Terms say exported output belongs to you.
best_use_for_portfolio: Design one signature gradient for the portfolio hero or case-study cover backgrounds, export it at 2x-4x WebP, and serve it as an optimized background image. Keep the share link so the gradient can be re-tuned for a colour refresh or a client's palette.
tier_reason: Grainy curve-shaped gradient art can set a mood, but it exports raster only and needs PRO for client use. Live-code gradient tools cover the same need better.
pick_over_overlaps: Use it only for one-off curve-shaped gradient art you will bake into images anyway.
score_rationale: Produces genuinely distinctive, banding-free gradient art that can set a site's visual tone. It only outputs raster images (no CSS, SVG or code), and the free tier is capped and non-commercial, so in a coded site it is limited to hero and background image assets.
free_tier: Full editor; 3 exports per day, max 10 per month; capped at Full HD (1x); no watermark; personal use only (no commercial or client work); login with a confirmed email required to export
paid_entry_label: PRO $9/mo billed monthly (or $59/yr billed annually, about $4.92/mo); VAT may apply
paid_top_label: Lifetime PRO License $99 one-time (same PRO features: unlimited exports, no resolution cap, commercial + client use, unlimited Figma plugin, beta features)
commercial_use_license: Proprietary SaaS. Terms (last updated 2026-03-20, governed by Ukrainian law) say output you create (e.g. exported gradients) is yours, but the site FAQ states the free plan is personal use only; commercial and client work requires PRO ($9/mo, $59/yr or $99 lifetime). 30-day money-back guarantee via Paddle.
agent_friendly: None found: no API, npm package, MCP or llms.txt (llms.txt returns 404). Outputs are PNG/WebP files an agent could only use as static assets once a human exports them.
maintenance_signal: Active: Terms last updated 2026-03-20; roadmap shows Templates Library and Figma plugin marked Done, animated gradients next (animation scripts already loaded in the app); Product Hunt listing live; copyright 2026.
caveats: Raster only (PNG/WebP), so not responsive or animatable in code and adds page weight; free exports are few, Full HD only, and not licensed for commercial use; login plus email confirmation needed to export; desktop-only app (mobile shows a message); no developer integration.
